meaning: slightly open, as of a door or a window

meaning: to walk at a slow, relaxed pace; such an unhurried walk

meaning: to make a low, feeble crying sound; such a sound

meaning: to dry up and shrivel; also to fade away by degrees

meaning: to fasten with a clasp; or to bend and give way under strain

meaning: to stick out beyond the surrounding surface

meaning: to work dough or clay by pressing and folding it with the hands; or to massage firmly

meaning: to settle comfortably into a warm or sheltered place
